content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined wool-blend blazer with a structured shoulder and notch lapel in charcoal grey (#3e4548), tailored to a relaxed fit for comfort. High-waisted wide-leg trousers made from soft crepe in deep olive green (#4b5320), falling to mid-calf length with a gentle drape. A silk-blend blouse with a subtle sheen in cream white (#f5f5dc), featuring a rounded neckline and drop shoulders for ease of movement. Minimalist leather ankle boots in black (#1a1a1a) with a low block heel, sized for all-day stability. The outfit works perfectly for an autumn office day by balancing professional polish with the comfort-first approach she requested; the dark and earthy tones create a sophisticated yet understated look that flatters her figure without drawing excessive attention. The wide-leg trousers provide freedom of movement while the blazer adds necessary structure for a neat casual aesthetic, ensuring she feels confident and at ease throughout her workday."}
